description.en: Performance of at least 20 ESD procedures in animal/ex vivo models with a target of ≥8 en bloc complete resections in the last 10 cases without perforation prior to first human ESD.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for esd in animal/ex vivo models but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs esd in animal/ex vivo models independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches esd in animal/ex vivo models to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
